# Your first app in 10 minutes

*[Português](FIRST_APP_IN_10_MINUTES.pt.md)*

About ten minutes of your attention. The downloads and the very first build can keep you waiting
longer on a slow connection (up to an hour in the worst case); the Manager shows progress the whole
time, so you can do something else meanwhile.

You need: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) or a 64-bit Linux desktop, **5 GB free** on disk, and internet.
You do **not** need Java, Python or any programming tool: the Manager brings its own.

## 1. Install the Manager

Download one file from [the latest release](https://github.com/MarceloGiazzon/NPDevGeneral/releases/latest):
on Windows the one ending `_x64-setup.exe`, on Linux the one ending `_amd64.AppImage`. Open it.

Windows will probably say **"Windows protected your PC"**: the Manager is not code-signed yet. Click
*More info*, then *Run anyway*. On Linux, mark the AppImage as executable (right-click › Properties)
and double-click it.

## 2. Choose your language

The Manager opens in **Set up**. The language picker is at the top right.

## 3. Install what is missing

Open **Set up › Install what is missing** and press its buttons **in order**, waiting for each to finish:

1. **Install private JDK**: Java (JDK 17), about 180 MB.
2. **Install private Python**: only if your computer has none; otherwise the screen already says it found yours.
3. **Refresh list**, keep the newest version, **Download this version**: NPDev itself.
4. **Run setup**: usually about a minute, sometimes about ten.

Not sure what one of these is? See the table in [The NPDev Manager, in plain words](MANAGER_GUIDE.md).

## 4. Check your computer

Open **Set up › Check my computer** and press **Re-check**. Each row has a mark:

- **✓** fine;
- **!** optional, usually ignore it (a **!** next to Docker or git is expected);
- **✗** must be fixed first; the row says how.

When there is no **✗** left, your computer is ready. You never have to do steps 3 and 4 again.

## 5. Create your app

Open **My apps › All apps**. Under **New app**:

- **Name**: a short name with letters, digits and hyphens, like `my-shop`;
- **Folder**: where to keep it, like your Documents folder (**Browse…** helps);
- **Database**: leave **H2Local**. It needs nothing installed and keeps your data.

Press **Create**. NPDev writes a first, working model (`model.json`) into a new folder. That file is your app.

## 6. Start it

Open **My apps › Start & stop**, pick your app in **App**, leave **Port** at `8080`, and press **▶ Run**.

The first start builds the whole application, so it takes a few minutes; the log below shows each
step. It is done when a line says **ready in …** with an address like `http://localhost:8080`.

## 7. Open it and sign in

Click the **App:** link. The page that opens asks for an **API Key**: the log printed it right after
the **ready in …** line, as `X-Api-Key: …`. Copy the text after `X-Api-Key:`, paste it into the
**API Key** field, then press **Open business screens** to see your app's own screens.

That is a working application: a database, screens to list and edit your data, and sign-in.

## 8. Change something

Leave the app running. Open `model.json` in your app's folder, add a field to one of its
concepts (Customer, Order...), and save. **My apps › Start & stop** notices the change and applies it, within seconds
(or about a minute when it has to rebuild); refresh the browser to see it. If you save a mistake, the log says exactly where, and the
app keeps running on the last version that worked.

Prefer to describe the change in words? Set up an AI in **Settings › AI**, then use
**My apps › Ask AI**.
